I replied to Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is IT ticket **#4092**.

The number comes from a message Ilse posted in #north-random on Oct 13. Dana is a member of that channel, so they could have seen it themselves. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, so I added that to the reply. I haven't checked the ticket's current status with IT.
